name: Abhishek Dahal
title: Web Developer & Digital Solutions Specialist
description: Personal portfolio of Abhishek Dahal, a web developer with practical experience in WordPress, Webflow, front-end development, website hosting, and digital project delivery.

intro.lead: I build, maintain, and optimize practical, reliable web experiences.
intro.sub: With hands-on experience at Pagoda Labs and ThemeGrill, I work across technical implementation (WordPress, Webflow, modern frontend), website hosting, DNS, database configuration, and content management to deliver seamless digital projects.

footer.text: Crafted with Eleventy (11ty). Clean, lightweight & statically generated for GitHub Pages.

experience.summary: Worked directly with 5+ clients to deliver tailored web solutions, manage infrastructure, and support multi-site digital workflows.
highlights: Worked directly with 5+ clients to understand business needs and deliver tailored website solutions.
Built responsive, user-friendly websites from Figma designs using WordPress and Webflow.
Managed 10+ concurrent web projects including updating website content and blogs, improving website performance, and resolving technical issues.
Applied SEO best practices to improve website structure, content discoverability, and search engine visibility.
Managed website infrastructure on Linode, including server setup, DNS configuration, and database management.
Delivered projects on schedule while maintaining website quality and client satisfaction.

experience.summary: Maintained popular WordPress themes and plugins with over 100,000 active installations and led e-commerce theme developments.
highlights: Maintained WordPress themes and plugins with over 100,000 active installations.
Led the development of 3 WooCommerce themes, increasing revenue by 10%.
Integrated modern WordPress trends into company workflow, improving team efficiency by 20%.
Integrated and configured 5+ external plugins to enhance product functionality.
Collaborated with support and marketing teams on product improvements, customer needs, and promotional campaigns.

experience.summary: Data cleaning, quality assurance, and visual reporting across datasets containing 60,000+ records.
highlights: Analysed and processed datasets containing 60,000+ records to identify issues and ensure data quality.
Cleaned, transformed, and organised data to support accurate analysis and reporting.
Created tables and visual reports to communicate findings and support data-driven decisions.

experience.summary: Supported University IT systems, library services, and conducted digital skills training sessions for students and staff.
highlights: Provided hands-on support for University IT systems and library services.
Assisted in delivering digital skills training sessions and peer-to-peer technical support.
Supported students and staff in developing digital literacy across the university.

experience.summary: Managing organization website and social media presence, producing digital content, and handling administrative tasks.
highlights: Managed social media channels and website to share organisational activities and engage supporters.
Produced digital content to raise awareness of the organization's mission and encourage donations.
Delivered academic support and mentoring to children promoting learning and personal development.
